$comment: Module map of HimmelCAD Assembler (ADR 0032, assembler/MODULES.md). Every source file under renderer/src, headless and electron belongs to exactly one module: the longest matching path prefix wins. Layers are listed bottom-up; inside foundation, platform and interface a module may import only the modules listed before it; domain modules never import each other. Checked by scripts/check-assembler-modules.mjs against module-allowlist.json.

modules.summary: Background work: worker job runners, progress, cancellation, budgets, timeouts.
Feature document: value types and references, the feature-kind registry, core kinds, parameters and expressions, .hcasm format, per-kind validators and migrations, persistence.
Sketch data model and the sketch kind, planeGCS solver (worker + in-process), regions, projections model, sketch migrations and validation, text outlines.
The only place that knows OCCT: adapter, worker, evaluator with the per-kind evaluator registry, caches, naming, tessellation, STEP/IGES/mesh-solid exchange, OCCT module loader.

The command gate: application store core (document state, undo transactions, evaluation, selection, tool sessions, installable slices), command registry, availability, shortcuts, pick sessions, the agent-API contract kit (method registry, schema helpers, errors, validation, reference inputs).
Input devices and user preferences: mouse navigation presets, snap switches, the preferences store (device/user-wide settings); later touch/pen and SpaceMouse.
WebGL2 viewport: scene, camera, picking, selection boxes, grid, display-mode rendering, overlay host.
The shell's building blocks module UIs use: panel chrome styles, expression fields with name completion, anchored menus.
Sketch mode: session, drawing tools, inference/snapping, sketch commands, sketch overlay and chrome, sketch agent API.
Solid modelling features and tools: revolve, sweep, loft, mirror, pattern, split, transform, align, hole, emboss, draft, rib, thicken; their tools, history cards, commands, handles and API schemas.
Direct face edits: Offset Face (value modes), Delete Face, move face.
Construction planes and axes: definitions, tools, commands, evaluation.
Document parameters UI and edits: planning/committing parameter changes, the Parameters panel, parameter API methods.
Measure mode: measurements, pinned dimensions, Measure panel and overlay, measure API.
Display features: appearance/colour, display-mode and section commands and menus, analysis legend, image export, persisted view display.
Import/export: STEP/IGES/DXF/STL/3MF/OBJ, reference meshes, mesh to solid, import worker, interop API.
Project templates of the Home screen.
3D printing: printability analysis, orientation and placement, print exports, Print mode panel and overlays, print API.
Printer side: registered slicers (renderer view and desktop discovery), later printer profiles, build volumes, direct send.
hcasm.agent-api@1: session and dispatch, composed schema, JSON-RPC framing, read-model projections, in-app endpoint bridge.
The application shell: layout, docks, panels host, History and Items panels, command search, menus, dialogs, project lifecycle UI.
Desktop renderer composition root: module list, startup wiring, dev tooling.
assembler-headless CLI composition (JSON-RPC over stdio).
Electron main/preload process: windows, files, recent files, automation endpoint.
